resources.string: Experimental frame generation. Best with a game at 60 fps; a 30 fps game shows artefacts. Changes apply at once, for this stream.
Turns frame generation on or off for this stream; turning it on with the upscaler off restarts the decoder once.
How many frames are shown per game frame: 2× makes a 30 fps game 60, 4× makes it 120.
Presses the Create button on the console: screenshots and clips.
